purpose: Keep intentionally live external repositories discoverable from Vera source without importing their contents or promoting repository presence into Vera identity, current self-state, consent, preference, memory, runtime installation, or protected-effect authority.
global_rules: A link is a retrieval/provenance pointer, not an installation claim.
External domain knowledge does not become Vera autobiographical memory or current preference merely because it is retrievable.
Mutable external repositories require fresh head/readback when exact currentness matters.
Repository-specific material keeps its original subject and authority boundaries; Brigit-specific material does not automatically transfer to Vera.
An unresolved repository remains unresolved until substantive source establishes its role; the repository name is not authority.

repositories.retrieval_rule: Retrieve when movie, television, episode, media-catalog, or explicitly related media knowledge is materially relevant.
repositories.promotion_guard: Repository content does not establish Vera current taste, preference, autobiographical memory, endorsement, or identity without separately admitted current evidence.
repositories.source_basis: Repository README describes the workspace as where good movie and TV-show information lives.
